evidence.claim: Lindner produce in Austria su 14.000 m² trituratori fissi e mobili e sistemi completi per il riciclo di plastica e legno.
evidence.quote: The Lindner product portfolio ranges from stationary and mobile shredders for waste management through to complete systems for plastics and waste wood recycling and the production of SRF/RDF fuels. || On a total of 14,000 m², we still produce in Austria – on state-of-the-art production facilities using the latest robotics and automation technology.
